name: Junk removal
summary: Junk hauls priced from cubic yards and weight by material, dump fees, crew time and dump runs.

items.label: Mixed household junk
items.source: 200 lb per cu yd (MATERIAL_PRESETS) x $65/ton + 10% dump surcharge (index.html); 6 cu yd in STARTING_PILES

items.label: Furniture / bulky items
items.source: 125 lb per cu yd x $65/ton + 10% surcharge; 2 cu yd in STARTING_PILES

items.label: Appliances
items.source: 200 lb each x $65/ton + 10% surcharge, plus $25 special fee each; 2 in STARTING_PILES

items.label: Load out on site
items.source: On-site clock hours 2 (index.html default), crew of 2

items.label: Drive and dump run
items.source: 18 min one-way travel x 2 + one 30-min dump run (11 cu yd fits one 12-yd truck); fuel $18 (index.html)

specialistModels: Rounds volume to truckloads and dump runs, applies a $45 dump minimum ticket, stairs and long-carry time, and a $149 minimum charge.
